rule_outs: Dwelling 6 m from the best section
summary: Short York Street kerb with homes 6-9 m away on the same side.

drivers.seclusion: Houses at 6, 8 and 9 m sit on the section's own side; a pool house fronts the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street where cars park along the kerb, so room to stop is fine.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, with a busy main road at the junction.
drivers.convention: Residents' cars park along the kerb; no sign of overnight campers.

flags: Noise from the adjoining main road
sun_shade: Open to the sky with tree shade at the junction end; sun from the north.

best_section.where: South side of York Street, about 25 m up from the main road junction
